entities.summary: Marats Kasems is a Latvian journalist and former editor-in-chief of Sputnik Lithuania, a media outlet operated by the Russian state agency Rossiya Segodnya. He became known for his involvement in Russian media, political activity in Latvia, and legal proceedings related to national security charges.
